scope: Local Chinese vector RAG integrated into the existing read-only LangChain CLI; no web UI or business write tools

deployment.runtime: CPUExecutionProvider; local files only after explicit prepare

verification.retrieval_caveat: Hand-written calibration/regression cases, not held-out data or a claim of 100% answer accuracy
verification.combined_graph_check: Real local BGE retrieval plus real LangChain graph, scripted fake generative model; verified airspace source section and zero MCP calls for knowledge-only question

boundaries: knowledge documents explain software rules, not official aviation law
source citation validity is not a semantic correctness proof
domain rejection uses a calibrated similarity heuristic
no dispatch, takeoff or emergency writes
retrieved project snippets are sent to DeepSeek only when the user runs the natural-language CLI
